summary: V2 testing of Cardapio Digital: store toggle, menus CRUD, staff RBAC, orders flow, customer checkout, admin Kanban. All 35 backend tests pass (24 new V2 + 11 regression). Frontend customer + admin flows verified end-to-end. Found and fixed one React useMemo dep bug in MenuPage that broke menu-tab filtering.

ui_bugs.issue: useMemo deps array missing 'activeMenu' caused menu tab filter to never re-apply — clicking Breakfast/Happy Hour did NOT filter products. FIXED by adding activeMenu to deps (line 84). Verified: Breakfast now correctly returns 0 products.

action_items: Optional: clean up TEST_ orders/products/menus/staff in DB created during testing (admin user TEST Store name persisted in store_settings — consider resetting if it shows in UI).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~760 lines and covers auth + storage + tags + products + menus + staff + orders + seed. Recommend splitting into routers/{auth,products,menus,staff,orders,store}.py and a separate seed module — per the >700 line threshold.

server.py uses CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False. Cookies are set with samesite='none', secure=True, httponly=True — correct, but since allow_credentials is False, browsers will not send cookies cross-origin. Frontend already uses Bearer token from localStorage (cd_token), so this works. Document the dual-auth model or set allow_credentials=True with explicit origins.

POST /api/orders calls get_current_user() inside a try/except to optionally identify staff. This swallows InvalidToken/ExpiredSignature errors silently and treats expired-token requests as guest orders. Consider distinguishing 'no token' vs 'invalid token' — invalid tokens should 401 even on guest endpoints.
_gen_order_code() uses random 4-digit code with no uniqueness check; collisions are possible (1/9000). Consider sequential daily counter or include date prefix.
Order list endpoint accepts 'limit' query as int but no upper bound; could return up to int max. Cap to e.g. 500.
Frontend MenuPage filter useMemo had a missing dep (fixed). General lint note: enable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps to catch similar issues.
Settings save button testid is 'save-settings-btn' (not 'settings-save' as referenced in the request) — verify the request's testid expectations align with implementation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after MenuPage fix (was failing menu-tab filter before)

Customer end-to-end checkout flow validated; admin Kanban Avancar button works (moves order pending→kitchen with toast confirmation).
rca of the issue: MenuPage.jsx line 84 useMemo deps array did not include 'activeMenu', so when user changed the active menu tab, React reused the cached filtered products list (which was filtered with activeMenu='all'). Fix: added activeMenu to deps. Verified by clicking Breakfast tab → empty state shown (0 cards), as expected since seeded products are linked only to Cardápio Principal.
